title: St. Exupéry, Killegar, Enniskerry, Co. Wicklow, A98VP46
seoTitle: St. Exupéry, Killegar, Enniskerry, Co. Wicklow, A98VP46
description:
Elevated detached bungalow with panoramic views in a highly accessible and sought-after country location.

St. Exupéry is a detached bungalow dating from circa 1965, occupying a most attractive elevated position with sweeping views towards the Great and Little Sugar Loaf and the Irish Sea beyond. Located on a quiet road on the Dublin–Wicklow border, the property enjoys a peaceful rural setting between the village of Enniskerry to the south and Kilternan to the north.

The property represents a superb opportunity for purchasers seeking a country home within close proximity to Dublin, an equestrian smallholding, or a residence with scope to create a modern family home in an exceptional setting. The sense of tranquillity and privacy is a notable feature and must be experienced to be fully appreciated.

Approached via a quiet country road, St. Exupéry is accessed through a wooden gate opening onto a generous driveway with ample parking. Lawns flank either side of the driveway, while a mature planted garden to the right of the entrance provides year-round interest and seasonal colour. The garden is beautifully established with a variety of mature trees, hedging and shrubs, offering sheltered outdoor space ideal for enjoying the summer months.

Extending to about 147 sq m (1,582 sq ft), the accommodation is arranged entirely at ground floor level. While the property would benefit from renovation, it offers a solid footprint and excellent potential to reimagine or extend subject to the relevant planning permissions.
The entrance porch, with WC and storage to either side, leads into a generous open-plan kitchen, living and dining area. This bright and inviting space is fitted with a range of built-in units and appliances and enjoys floor-to-ceiling sliding doors opening onto the front terrace, perfectly framing the spectacular views. The south-east facing terrace provides a private and sheltered setting from which to take in the surrounding landscape. A large built-in pantry is located off the kitchen.

To the right of the open-plan living space is a separate reception room featuring a wood-burning stove and expansive views, with a connection back to the main living area.
Further accommodation comprises a spacious hall currently utilised as a study or home office, three generous double bedrooms all with excellent natural light, and a well-proportioned family bathroom with built-in storage.

Outbuildings

Two block-built stables are located adjacent to convenient access to the rear paddock. A carport attached to the property leads to a block of lockable sheds housing the boiler and pumphouse, providing valuable storage and potential use as a tack room.

Gardens & Grounds

The land extends to about 3 acres and is laid out in a combination of lawn, paving and two well-defined paddocks. New post-and-rail fencing encloses both paddocks.
The front paddock extends to about 1 acre and is suitable for a variety of uses including grazing, small-scale farming or the creation of a ménage, as previously utilised. It benefits from separate gated road access.

The rear paddock, extending to about 2 acres, enjoys truly outstanding 360-degree views encompassing forestry, sea and mountain scenery, offering a rare sense of space and natural beauty.

Often referred to as the Garden of Ireland, County Wicklow continues to attract purchasers seeking space, privacy and an exceptional natural setting while remaining within easy reach of Dublin. Killegar represents an ideal balance of countryside living and accessibility, and St. Exupéry occupies a picturesque hillside position, offering privacy, versatility and exceptional outlooks.

The popular village of Enniskerry lies less than 3 km away and is renowned for its charming character and excellent range of amenities including cafés, restaurants, boutiques, specialist shops and everyday services such as a library, churches, salons and Garda station. Carrickmines Park Shopping Centre is also close at hand, providing extensive retail, dining and lifestyle offerings.

The area is particularly well served for sport and leisure. Enniskerry Football Club is located within the village, while some of Ireland's most highly regarded golf clubs are nearby, including Powerscourt, Druids Glen and Dún Laoghaire Golf Club. The Ski Club of Ireland at Kilternan caters for alpine enthusiasts, while the surrounding countryside and coastline provide outstanding opportunities for hiking, trail running, mountain biking and sea swimming. Beechhill Allotments, located directly across the road, will appeal to those with an interest in growing their own produce.

Equestrian facilities in the area are exceptional with quiet country roads offering excellent hacking opportunities. A strong local equestrian community enjoys forest trails nearby, riding schools and livery yards, including Killegar Stables just a few hundred metres from the property, Enniskerry Horse Farm at neighbouring Monastery, and Brennanstown Riding School (approximately 6 km). Additional equestrian centres for schooling and competition include Boswell Equestrian Centre in Ashford (25km) and Marlton Equestrian near Wicklow Town (35km). A local highlight is the annual Kilmacanogue Show, running for over 50 years, with more than 70 classes and all within hacking distance of the property.

The wider area offers an abundance of attractions, including Powerscourt Gardens and Waterfall, Kilruddery Gardens, the Sugar Loaf Mountain and Avoca Handweavers, with Mount Usher Gardens, Glendalough, Kilmacurragh Gardens and the beaches of Brittas Bay all within easy driving distance.
An excellent choice of schools is available locally, including Powerscourt National School, Enniskerry National School, Presentation Bray Secondary School and St. Gerard's School, along with Enniskerry Montessori & After School Care.

Dublin Airport is located approximately 40 km away, providing excellent international connectivity. Public transport is readily accessible via Dublin Bus Route 44, a short walk from the property, offering services to Enniskerry and Dublin city centre. The Glenamuck District Distributor Road further enhances access to the M50 and national road network.
